nodes.label: 发现—承诺边界 claim 合同
nodes.description: Q34 typed claim/proposition contract separating discovery of a candidate claim from commitment as a current conclusion.

nodes.label: 发现—承诺 承诺门禁
nodes.description: Q34 fail-closed deterministic commitment gate/CLI: blocks premature, circular, ceiling-breach, analogy-as-mechanism, stale-head, selective, unattested, self-approved commitments.

nodes.label: 发现—承诺 Q33 试点
nodes.description: Q34 pilot claim proving the boundary: 7 Q33 components Current in Main (allowed) vs global-copyright-compliance (blocked by ceiling).

nodes.label: 责任—权限—行动轨迹 合同
nodes.description: Q35 typed responsibility-authority-action-trace contract: actor/role, authority grant, action intent/decision/execution, append-only hash-linked trajectory, responsibility attribution.

nodes.label: 责任—权限 门禁
nodes.description: Q35 fail-closed responsibility gate/CLI: blocks self-grant, model-name-as-authority, expired/revoked grant, scope breach, broken delegation, separation-of-duty, stale head, ceiling breach, uncommitted action, chain tamper, silent rewrite, Q33 bypass, forced many-hands.

nodes.label: 责任—权限 Q34 试点
nodes.description: Q35 pilot: controlled repository operation on Q34 Draft PR with separated roles (initiator/authorizer/executor/verifier); proves role separation without claiming Q34 candidate is Main-accepted.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 合同
nodes.description: Q36-OBS typed observation-prediction calibration contract: observation spec (event time vs available time), freeze-before-reveal prediction commitment, independent outcome binding, deterministic evaluation/calibration, residual/anomaly preservation with do-not-infer-cause marker.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 门禁
nodes.description: Q36-OBS fail-closed observation-prediction calibration gate/CLI: blocks temporal leaks, target/window/scope mismatch, stale heads, silent prediction rewrites, selective outcome deletion, self-generated outcomes, illegal probabilities, uncommitted-Q34-claim predictions, missing Q35 authority, Q33 rights bypass, universal-capability and causal overclaims, unbound calibration, dropped failures.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 Q34 试点
nodes.description: Q36-OBS pilot: freeze-before-reveal interval prediction about Q34 propagation-closure drift, bound to an independent deterministic outcome observation with calibration record; plus an honestly-marked retrospective replay fixture (RETROSPECTIVE_REPLAY_NOT_LIVE_FORECAST).

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 合同
nodes.description: Q36-INT typed intervention-failure dynamics contract: intervention request (Q34-committed claim + Q35 authority + Q36-OBS read-only observation/residual), safety envelope, controlled execution record, outcome/effect evaluation with baseline/comparator, failure mode record, and stop/rollback history; fail-closed against uncommitted claims, missing authority, residual-as-cause, external action, envelope exceed, stop-condition violation, failure rewrite, expected-effect rewrite, causal/universal overclaim, incomplete rollback, many-hands forgery, unvalidated observation, separation-of-duty violation, missing baseline.

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 门禁
nodes.description: Q36-INT fail-closed intervention-failure dynamics gate/CLI: blocks Q14 uncommitted claims, Q35 authority gaps, Q33 rights bypass, missing safety envelope/stop/rollback, real-world external action, envelope exceed, stop-condition violation, failure rewrite, expected-effect rewrite, causal/universal overclaim, incomplete rollback, many-hands forgery, unvalidated observation, separation-of-duty violation, missing baseline. Deterministic exit codes 0-20.

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 受控试点
nodes.description: Q36-INT controlled pilot: deterministic repo-local replay of an intervention bundle with Q34 claim + Q35 grant + Q36-OBS observation, asserting the fail-closed gate passes (exit 0) and stop/rollback are append-only and verified; plus 23 attack/positive fixtures. No Main mutation, no external real-world system access or control.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 合同
nodes.description: Q37-I1 typed analogy-audit & transportability contract: analogy candidates (SURFACE_SIMILARITY / METAPHOR_ONLY / STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY / MECHANISM_CANDIDATE / TRANSPORTABILITY_CANDIDATE / COUNTERANALOGY), explicit mappings (entities, correspondence, cardinality, directionality, invariants, mismatches, omitted variables, hidden premises, scale/time/context differences, digest), mechanism evidence (distinct from shared form), transportability assessments (overlap, invariances, shifts, boundary, falsifier, uncertainty), and audit decisions with claim ceiling; fail-closed against metaphor/local-isomorphism/selective-correspondence/unaudited-structural-map/Q36-residual upgraded to mechanism identity, undeclared shift, residual-as-cause, mechanism upgrade, transportability without overlap/invariance/boundary/falsifier, suppressed counteranalogy, Q14 uncommitted claim, Q35 authority gap, Q33 rights bypass, Q38 premature start, claim-ceiling overreach. Does NOT prove shared mechanism, real-world transportability or universal law; does NOT add L7/truth layer; does NOT materialize F15/D1/D2.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 门禁
nodes.description: Q37-I1 fail-closed analogy-audit & transportability gate/CLI: blocks metaphor/local-isomorphism/selective-correspondence/unaudited-structural-map/Q36-residual upgraded to mechanism identity or universal law, undeclared scale/time/context or transportability shift, mechanism evidence insufficient/circular, residual-as-cause, transportability missing overlap/invariance/boundary/falsifier, suppressed counteranalogy/negative evidence, Q14 uncommitted claim, Q35 authority gap/expiry/scope-mismatch, Q33 rights bypass, Q38 premature start, claim-ceiling overreach, semantic inconsistency. Deterministic exit codes 0-21.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 受控试点
nodes.description: Q37-I1 real-repo pilot: deterministic repo-local replay of an analogy bundle against the real Q34 committed claim (fix.analogy_as_mechanism from data/discovery/fixtures/05-analogy-as-mechanism.json), asserting the fail-closed gate passes (exit 0) and that Q38 case retrieval remains gated (q38_search_permission NOT_ALLOWED / ALLOWED_AS_RESTRICTED_SEED only). Plus 30 attack/positive fixtures. No Main mutation, no Q38 case retrieval, no external real-world system access or control.
